rationale: The required approval must survive handoffs, yet the user reports that ownership becomes unclear and status channels disagree about progress. Inspection established only `state=blocked`, leaving the cause unknown. The redesign gives each submission one ID, keeps the sender responsible until acceptance, binds approval to a revision, and reconciles billing before retry. Concrete scenarios cover these transitions, accessibility, and unrelated state. Their outcomes are presented as expectations. Policy details and billing lookup capability remain open implementation questions. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match.
